dedupe_keys.name: agencia portuguesa do ambiente port and maritime datasets

description: Agência Portuguesa do Ambiente: port and maritime datasets is a collection of datasets listed in data.gov.pt, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Agência Portuguesa do Ambiente. Coverage: Agência Portuguesa do Ambiente. The listing groups 12 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about port and maritime; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Programas da Orla Costeira (POC) - Áreas Portuárias; Timor Portos; Atlas do Ambiente - Recursos Hídricos Superficiais - Bacias do Porto S; Atlas do Ambiente - Recursos Hídricos Subterrâneos - Porto Santo. Formats seen: ZIP, WFS, PDF, WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-dados-gov-pt.
